notes.title: Game installation update
notes.content: Changed game installation so that it installs 64-bit Java, if user have 32-bit Java installed.

notes.title: Java notice
notes.content: [p]Please note that this game requires 64-bit Java.[/p][p][/p][p]If you run this game with 32-bit Java, the next level may not be loaded.[/p][p][/p][p]You can check, which Java you have with command: Java -version in command prompt. [/p][p][/p][p]If you have 32-bit Java, you may install 64-bit Java here: [url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ahmgLTARrVv8xGRwEq33T_UF2KeMEHrk/view?usp=drive_link"]64-bit Java installation[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Just run the exe file.[/p]
